Libero da conflitti

An indication that the aircraft is no longer in a conflicting situation with another aircraft.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Libero da conflitti?

In this glossary, Libero da conflitti refers to: An indication that the aircraft is no longer in a conflicting situation with another aircraft.

How is Libero da conflitti used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Pilota, sei libero da conflitti con il traffico alle tue dodici."

Why does Libero da conflitti matter in aviation?

Libero da conflitti matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Libero da conflitti?

Libero da conflitti is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Libero da conflitti belong to?

In this glossary, Libero da conflitti is grouped under Basic ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

An indication that the aircraft is no longer in a conflicting situation with another aircraft.

Operational example

Pilot, you are clear of conflict with traffic at your twelve o'clock.
